content:
Jamie: paging — ACME (dedicated pool dp-45, VPC) reports a sharp quality regression after yesterday's quantization profile update. Multiple customer queries: model hallucinating product SKUs and confident wrong facts. Customer impact: core user flows failing. sending logs and a sample prompt now.
Ash (oncall): acknowledged, I'm on it. severity: S2 as it's a single tenant but high impact > immediate mitigation. tagging ml + infra.
deploy-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — #2932109876 — Pager triggered to oncall
Zoë (ml): thanks. pulling eval diffs now. do we know which quant profile was applied?
Jamie: applied profile: q4_optimized_v2 at 2026-03-14T22:12Z as part of nightly rollout to dp-45. I have the rollout audit: user=ops-batch, changelist=qc-823.
Raj (infra): dp-45 is isolated to ACME-prod — good, tenant isolation working. we can revert without affecting other tenants, but need to ensure model variant compatibility.
Zoë (ml): initial quick check on sample set: perplexity up ~25% vs baseline, top-3 token probs shifted, and some deterministic token rounding errors in the quantized kernels. looks like q4_optimized_v2 overaggressive weight clipping on attention projections.
Ash (oncall): propose three-phase mitigation: 1) reroute ACME traffic to fallback model variant (fp16 baseline) in same pool if capacity allows; 2) revert quant profile on dp-45 for ACME to q4_stable_v1; 3) run targeted eval tests and keep customer updated. any objections?
Zoë (ml): +1 for rollback. fallback to fp16 will cost more tokens but buys time. we should also snapshot current model state and logs. I'll prepare a quick eval harness to sanity-check after rollback.
Raj (infra): capacity check: dp-45 has some reserved headroom but routing to fp16 might require spinning up one extra node. I can add a node and update routing. command to add node (k8s/infra console):
```
# add node to dp-45 pool
kubectl scale deploy/dp-45-inference --replicas=5 -n redwood-dedicated
```
I'll start that now. expected ~3-4min.
Ash (oncall): Jamie, can you message ACME CSM with a heads-up: "We're investigating a regression affecting your dedicated inference — temporary mitigation in progress, ETA ~15-30m for initial rollback. Will follow up with postmortem." Keep tone calm.
Jamie: on it. pinged CSM + technical contact. attached sample prompts and topbad outputs.
deploy-bot: Action queued: scale dp-45 to 5 replicas by Raj — started 2932109940
Raj (infra): node up, routing update ready.
Zoë (ml): ready to flip rollback. rollback steps (internal CLI):
```
# revert quant profile for tenant ACME on pool dp-45
redwoodctl tenant-config set --tenant acme --pool dp-45 --quant-profile q4_stable_v1 --force --reason "incident 2932109876 revert"
# verify
redwoodctl tenant-config get --tenant acme --pool dp-45
```
Ash (oncall): I'm handing exec to Zoë for ML-critical ops. Ben (oncall-next) standby for handoff.
Zoë (ml): executing rollback now. will post logs.
deploy-bot: ROLLING CHANGE STARTED by Zoë at 2932110075 — operation id ocp-29321-01
Zoë (ml): rollback command completed, verifying model process health.
Zoë (ml): quick sanity eval on 50 samples: top-1 matches baseline for 42/50, hallucination rate dropped to baseline levels. still running extended checks.
Ash (oncall): good early signal. Raj, can you confirm routing cutover complete and no 5xx spikes?
Raj (infra): routing done. no 5xx spikes. latency +2% due to fp16 variant load, within SLO.
Jamie: CSM update sent: "We've initiated a rollback to a stable quant profile and routed to fallback variant. Expect full restoration in ~10m. We'll share results and next steps."
Zoë (ml): extended eval (1k prompts) done: quality metrics back to expected; minor token probability divergence but within acceptable variance. recommend keeping q4_stable_v1 for ACME while we debug q4_optimized_v2 on a non-prod pool.
Ash (oncall): agreed. next steps: 1) keep ACME on stable profile; 2) run deeper kernel-level diagnosis on q4_optimized_v2; 3) plan controlled canary with narrower prompt set; 4) schedule postmortem. Owner: Zoë (ml) for root cause, Raj for infra action items, Ash will author incident timeline.
Ben (oncall-next): I'm taking over incident watch for the night. Ash — any open actions I should pick up now?
Ash (oncall): handoff notes: monitor ACME error rates & latency, confirm customer-facing post after RC, and help track follow-up bugs: #ISSUE-931 (quant clip regression) assigned to Zoë. contact list pinned in thread.
Zoë (ml): creating bug and attaching eval artifacts + quant traces. plan: repro on dev-pool with same kernels, enable fp32 reference run, and collect KV-cache traces. ETA 48h for first analysis.
Raj (infra): I'll rollback the rollout pipeline to block q4_optimized_v2 auto-promotes for dp-45 and add a CI job to run prompt-set smoke tests before profile promotion.
deploy-bot: ROLLING CHANGE COMPLETE — ocp-29321-01 at 2932110320 — status: success
Ash (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for customer. still S2 while root cause investigation ongoing. Jamie, please send customer final update: what we did, why, expected follow-ups, and offer a technical sync.
Jamie: sending final update now. includes note about stability and next steps.
Zoë (ml): saving analysis artifacts to /mnt/incident_artifacts/2932109876.zip and will link to postmortem.
Ash (oncall): thanks team. formal postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. handoff complete to Ben.
Ben (oncall-next): taking it from here, monitoring. feel free to DM if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
